why_it_passes: An action that spends money: a command buys a web address with the saved payment card; the card says the price, why now and what waiting risks.

card.title: Buy the web address for the new booking site, $18 a year?
card.context: The new booking site needs its own web address before we can send the link to customers. The address we picked is free today and costs $18 a year. Someone else could buy it first; then we would need a new name and new printed cards.
card.question: Should zm buy the address now, for $18 a year?

choices.label: Yes, buy it now
choices.pros: the name is ours; the site can go out next week as planned
choices.cons: $18 a year on the company card

choices.label: Wait until the site is finished
choices.pros: no cost for a few more weeks
choices.cons: someone may take the name, and the printed cards would be wrong

card.why: $18 a year is small next to reprinting cards; buying now keeps next week's plan.

action.shown: If you choose A, this command runs on larch, as you: ./scripts/buy-domain.sh booking-example.com --years 1. Any other answer does nothing.
